items.statement: The four tautomer endpoint calculations are validated as minima and the three transition-state calculations are validated by harmonic frequencies and endpoint connectivity.
items.expected: All accepted minima have zero imaginary frequencies; each accepted TS has one imaginary frequency consistent with its named R↔P channel and a connectivity check.

items.statement: The gas-phase reaction energy changes distinguish the three R-to-P channels.
items.expected: R→P1 ΔE is negative, while R→P2 and R→P3 ΔE are positive; submitted values identify all three channels.

items.statement: The forward activation barriers follow a definite channel ordering.
items.expected: The ordering is R→TS1 lowest, R→TS3 intermediate, R→TS2 highest, with all three forward barriers reported.
